gauge.name: Wailuku River at Piihonoua

impacts.statement: Flooding affecting homes and properties in Piihonua. Also an indirect indicator of Alenaio Stream in downtown Hilo at maximum capacity. Bayfront area flooding. Kamehameha Ave. and lower Pauahi St. closed. Other normally flood prone roads also closed.
